newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gentech to announce deal soon - sources.
newsitem.headline: Gentech to announce deal soon - sources.

text.p: South African cash shell General Technologies Ltd (Gentech) is set to soon announce a deal with a firm that will put assets into the company, industry sources said on Wednesday.
"There should be something announced shortly," one source said.
Gentech's share price has moved sharply on Tuesday, dropping to a new year low of 32 cents in volumes of more than 1.6 million shares. At 1220 GMT the firm was at 32 cents, down 22 cents.
The sources said the firm was likely to make inquiries to see if any information had been leaked to the market.
A company spokesman said the firm could not comment on the share price movement. "I cannot comment on that," he said.
In a deal last summer Gentech, formerly a holding company for investment in the electrical goods industry, became a cash shell owned by Powertech Ltd.
Dealers said the share price move was due to rumours the firm is set to link up with an unnamed electronics firm. "There are rumours about a tie-up," one trader said.
